title: Methylenedioxy cathinones (bk-MDMA family)
disclaimer: Game catalog. No recipes, precursors, doses, or injection SOP. Unknown scores are null, never 0. Pleasure and compulsiveness scored independently.

compounds.name: Methylone
compounds.one_liner: Tuesday night Molly. The hug is real. The clock is cruel.
compounds.positives_writeup: Only lone with a controlled human MDMA comparison: euphoria, wellbeing, empathy, faster on and earlier gone. Erowid reads like a roll — love, closeness, music, this-moment-is-perfect. Rush is a lift, not slam poetry. Enjoyment stays high because the hug is documented, not folklore.
compounds.negatives_writeup: Short clock. Bluelight: kinda rolling, then poof — redose chase. Jaw, sweat, heart tick in the RCT. Hangover is real but not pyro wreckage. Sold as Molly since Explosion bags.

feel.headline: Tuesday night Molly. The hug is real. The clock is cruel.

rush.note: Fast lift, short; not slam-poem energy.

enjoyment.note: Closest honest MDMA-lite on the wall.

compulsiveness.note: Short duration redose, not pyro vacuum.

reinforcement.note: Abuse potential comparable to MDMA in humans.

sociability.note: Empathy and talk are the point.

paranoia.note: Listed on Erowid negatives; not the lead story.

aftereffects.note: After effects 1–6 h vault; crash from the short peak.

psychosis_concern.note: Class stim risk, not a famous outbreak.

cardiovascular.note: BP/HR up vs placebo in RCT; palpitations in vault.

sleep.note: Stim leftover after the hug dies.

compounds.npc_line: Tuesday night Molly.

sources.title: Poyatos et al. Methylone vs MDMA in humans

gaps: No modern street-batch vs RCT-batch comparison.
Shulgin 'not the unique magic' vs user 'Tuesday Molly' is a real split.

compounds.name: Ethylone
compounds.one_liner: Sit down or you miss it. Quiet roll, not a siren.
compounds.positives_writeup: Bluelight: waves, tactile, music, libido, subtle. Longer night than methylone's pop. Some prefer it. Empathy is there if you sit still.
compounds.negatives_writeup: Easy to miss in a club. More stim/less therapeutic hug than MDMA on PW. SERT step-down from methylone. Confused with ephylone by name.

feel.headline: Sit down or you miss it. Quiet roll, not a siren.

reinforcement.note: In-vitro releaser/blocker mix; no human abuse trial.

cardiovascular.note: Stim BP/HR; one BL pulse anecdote.

compounds.name: Butylone
compounds.one_liner: Longer tail, flatter hug. Stim wearing an MD shirt.
compounds.positives_writeup: Some BL: more euphoria than ethylone, less saucer-eyes and less connectedness. Rats self-admin. Hybrid DAT-block / SERT-release still lifts DA and motion.
compounds.negatives_writeup: PW: more classic stim than entactogen. House card: longer, flatter. One Erowid cocktail just calls it shitty. Serotonin-syndrome case with methylone in a fake-ecstasy cap.

feel.headline: Longer tail, flatter hug. Stim wearing an MD shirt.

compulsiveness.note: Below pentylone; rats still take it.

cardiovascular.note: With methylone: lethal serotonin syndrome case.

compounds.name: Pentylone
compounds.one_liner: First of the lones that would rather steal than hug.
compounds.positives_writeup: One loud Erowid: unique, euphoric, route-dependent movies (no SOP here). Rush can be the high number on this wall. Music/function stories exist.
compounds.negatives_writeup: Most DAT-leaning of the methylone/butylone/pentylone trio. Partial MDMA cue only. Strongest progressive-ratio self-admin. Vape-talk paranoia in that same report. After 2021, pentylone in blood often means dipentylone metabolite — don't double-count.

feel.headline: First of the lones that would rather steal than hug.

rush.note: Route-myth: some ROAs hit; we do not write them.

compulsiveness.note: Highest PR self-admin of the three (Dolan).

aftereffects.note: One report claimed no chemical hangover; treat as anecdote.

compounds.npc_line: First of the lones that would rather steal than hug.

gaps: Thin first-person set besides one glowing Erowid.
Post-2021 tox: parent vs metabolite confusion.

compounds.name: Eutylone
compounds.one_liner: They pressed it in Molly pills anyway.
compounds.positives_writeup: Low-dose sliver of glow; music can slap (reddit). Tiny empathy at the bottom of the bag. That's the whole compliment.
compounds.negatives_writeup: 2019–21 US king. CDC deaths. WHO Schedule II. Hybrid pentylone-shaped. BL: entactogen 2/10, meth substitute that isn't enjoyable, heart/heat/headache amplified. NZ checking: kids thought MDMA; some unwell for days. First hour is 'is this it?' — bag answers.

feel.headline: They pressed it in Molly pills anyway.

enjoyment.note: Shitty-drug consensus with rare low-dose fans.

compulsiveness.note: WHO: high abuse potential chatter; redose the empty roll.

reinforcement.note: Meth-like in animal abuse model; market persistence.

aftereffects.note: NZ: unwell up to ~10 days in scare copy.

compounds.npc_line: They pressed it in Molly pills anyway.

compounds.name: Ephylone
compounds.one_liner: Don't press this as ecstasy. The heart remembers.
compounds.positives_writeup: PW/BL: stim, some enthusiasm rumor, a rush that is sharp not satisfying. That's the compliment. Do not confuse with N-ethylpentedrone (also 'NEP').
compounds.negatives_writeup: 2016–18 death wave. Krotulski series; 23 fatalities in 2017–20 review. PW: empathy weak, sides outrun pleasure, compulsive redose looking for a roll that isn't there. BL: awkward adrenergic stim, vasoconstriction stories, heart screaming. Psychosis/hallucination in hospital cases.

feel.headline: Don't press this as ecstasy. The heart remembers.

compulsiveness.note: Redose to find a hug that never arrives.

cardiovascular.note: Cardiac arrest / extreme tachy stories; highest CV flag on the wall.

compounds.npc_line: Don't press this as ecstasy.
gaps: Slam-era posts exist; catalog will not turn them into SOP.

compounds.name: Dipentylone
compounds.one_liner: Molly stamp. Meth manners. The metabolite is pentylone.
compounds.positives_writeup: Almost no first-person library. Market replaced eutylone in weeks. Do not invent a hug.
compounds.negatives_writeup: DAT IC50 49 nM vs SERT 4990 nM — hundred-fold cold. 125 PM cases. Pentylone in 98% as metabolite. Pressed as Ecstasy/Molly. Labs mix it with a crowd of isomers. Pleasure scores are inferred cold, confidence C.

feel.headline: Molly stamp. Meth manners. The metabolite is pentylone.

euphoria.note: DAT>>SERT. Not a roll on paper.

enjoyment.note: Inferred low. Upgrade only if threads appear.

sociability.note: Sold as Molly. Transporters say no.

paranoia.note: Class stim + analog series, not a diary.

compounds.name: Dibutylone
compounds.one_liner: Same carbons as eutylone. Half the room hugged. Half wanted a refund.
compounds.positives_writeup: One BL camp: warm sparkle, music, empathy, safer-feeling than ephylone. Gatch: meth, coke, and MDMA substitution. Do not average the hate into low euphoria.
compounds.negatives_writeup: Other camp: shittiest RC, disappointment at common amounts. UK PM mentions. Butylone in every dibutylone blood (metabolite). Oral-inactive rumor is a vendor myth some posts fight.

compounds.one_liner: They put a benzyl on it and the party left.
compounds.positives_writeup: Almost none. One forum crumb of mild oral/insufflation. WHO: not a significant psychomotor stimulant.
compounds.negatives_writeup: Does not substitute for MDMA. SERT negligible. Six PM cases, always poly. UK seizures exist. The lone that forgot to work.

compounds.positives_writeup: None we trust. Do not invent 'like eutylone.'
compounds.negatives_writeup: Virginia 2024–25: 170 CS cases, handful of PM bloods. Sold as MDMA in NZ 2024 and Europe 2025. NFLIS late-2024 most prevalent US cathinone for a minute. No published human-toxicity series yet (Axis).
